## About Us

#### Our Formulations

A. Photochemical Formulations • To process X-Ray & Imaging Films • To process Industrial X-Ray Films • To Process Digital Color Paper • To process Graphic Art, Recording Films • To process Dental X-Ray Films

B. Other Formulations • Photogel-Ultra Sono Gel • UV Cure Chemical

#### Countrywide Distribution

The products manufactured by us are distributed across the country through the Dealer Network and it is patronized by reputed hospitals, diagnostic centers, dentists, color photofinishing labs, image processors and printing houses.

ISO Certified Organization

We follow the ISO quality norms. And hence we are certified with ISO 9001: 2015 standards. The Quality Management System is applicable to : “Manufacturing of Chemical Preparations for Photographic Use”.

Manufacturing Unit

Our Factory is well equipped having State-Of-The-Art Infrastructure to manufacture products with consistent quality & supplies. We are strategically located in a designated Chemical Manufacturing Zone, just at a distance of 100 Kms. from Mumbai. Contact us for further information.
